criteria.target: Map the public Harness execution lane, the inbound/outbox worker lane, and the inline webhook branch from entrypoint through persistence, worker selector, runtime composition, and observable response; distinguish current implementation from intended topology.
criteria.evidence_method: Compare the Discovery map with cited API routes, worker selectors, store implementations, and public Harness factory/worker call sites.
criteria.conditions: Static source inspection only; no runtime or end-to-end behavior may be inferred.
criteria.validity_notes: Findings apply to the already-dirty worktree observed on 2026-09-23.

criteria.target: Identify public composition and persistence ports and state which requested trace fields are present, absent, or not demonstrably joined across entry, policy, approval, tool, journal, and response.
criteria.evidence_method: Compare RuntimeInput, policy/approval/tool/audit contracts, effect-journal keys, execution persistence, and API response paths; qualify all gaps as static observations.
criteria.conditions: Do not claim a single end-to-end persisted trace from field presence alone.
criteria.validity_notes: Static type and call-path evidence does not establish runtime persistence or behavior.

criteria.target: Name evidence-backed candidate legacy paths, identify competing interpretations of the phrase 'two legacy paths', and leave product scope unresolved for human decision where source documents do not settle it.
criteria.evidence_method: Cross-check roadmap wording against worker runtime selectors, webhook ingress modes, and existing architecture/audit documentation.
criteria.conditions: The Discovery must not choose a parity contract by inference.
criteria.validity_notes: Current source supports more than one plausible meaning of the unnamed pair.
